messages.author: 55cb20da3fe82e18
messages.subject: bootstrap datepicker - date doesn't update
parts:
I've been playing around with the bootstrap datepicker (http://www.eyecon.ro/bootstrap-datepicker/) I can get the widget to show up and work - however, after selecting the date from the widget, it doesn't register in shiny until i press Enter. I don't know if I'm missing some javascript - I include the following:

$(document).ready(function(){
    $('#dp1').datepicker({
      format: 'yyyy-mm-dd'
    });
    $('#dp2').datepicker();
    $('#dp3').datepicker();
    $('#dp3').datepicker();
  });

and then just use:   textInput("dp2", "Date:") in ui.R (see attached working example)

It seems like I'm missing something in the javascript code - does anyone have suggestions on how to get it work?

Thanks

-Haider
